subject.title: Slack: Show tool-level progress in assistant thread status

question: Should Slack native assistant-thread status show sanitized per-tool progress, or should tool progress remain in loading messages, preview progress, task cards, and opt-in status reactions?
rationale: Current source proves the wiring gap, but the desired behavior depends on Slack UX, privacy/disclosure, and overlap with existing progress surfaces rather than a narrow broken-code repair.

options.title: Decide Policy First
options.body: Keep this issue open and resolve the Slack progress-disclosure policy before accepting another per-tool native status implementation.

options.title: Implement Sanitized Native Status
options.body: Allow a narrow Slack-owned implementation that reuses sanitized progress labels, dedupes repeated writes, clears reliably, and proves live Slack behavior.

options.title: Keep Native Status Generic
options.body: Close or narrow this request only if maintainers decide native Slack status should remain generic and progress detail belongs solely in existing surfaces.

recommendation.title: Decide Policy First
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and resolve the Slack progress-disclosure policy before accepting another per-tool native status implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the most recent native-status default policy change and merged the loading-message work, making them the strongest routing candidate for this product choice.
